semantics.routine: Normal asynchronous delivery; wait for the next natural ready boundary.
semantics.priority: Deliver ahead of routine traffic at the next verified boundary without interrupting active work by default.
semantics.immediate: Time-sensitive traffic that may request one fenced graceful steering transition and requires acknowledgement and disposition.
semantics.flash: An explicit safety or authority conflict requiring the shortest authorized fenced interruption path and immediate escalation on failure.
